notes: Table continues from leaf 276 and onto leaf 278 (European Languages concluded). African (cols 99-101) is printed under the heading 'Vernaculars of other Asiatic Countries and Africa'; 'Others' (96-98) is the Asiatic 'Others'. The European 'Total' (102-104) here includes languages continued on p.272 (leaf 278). Print inconsistency (kept as printed, re-read at high zoom): Amritsar Asiatic Total 1,184 / 511 / 673 but Persian 1,168/500/668 + Arabic 10/8/2 + Chinese 5/2/3 + Others 2/1/1 = 1,185/511/674 (persons and females 1 short). The same 1-unit shortfall carries into the printed Lahore Division (3,122/1,433), British Territory (4,661/2,123) and Punjab (4,875/2,161) Asiatic totals, which are otherwise consistent with the district totals. All area sums and P=M+F checks pass.
